brief:
Israeli demonstrators gathered in Tel Aviv on Saturday to protest against settler violence targeting Palestinians in the occupied West Bank, according to Middle East Eye. The protesters characterized the campaign of attacks as ethnic cleansing and called for an end to the violence.

The demonstration reflected growing concern among segments of Israeli society over escalating tensions and attacks on Palestinian communities by settlers in the territory.
